original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports that stablecoin wallets are now directly challenging traditional bank accounts as primary consumer money hubs. This structural shift alters liquidity dynamics for $BTC. When capital settles natively on-chain in stablecoins rather than off-ramping to legacy banks, market pullbacks lose their historical liquidity drain. With $BTC holding near $78,790 inside a compressed 2.1% daily range, available USD dry powder sits directly on trading rails instead of waiting on bank wires—creating faster support re-entries on dips.
